title: First hundred
description: Answer 100 drill spots. Enough reps that the common ones start to feel familiar.

title: Two thousand spots
description: Answer 2,000 drill spots. At this point the charts are yours, not the app's.

title: Three days running
description: Practise three days in a row.

title: A full week
description: Practise seven days in a row.

title: Thirty days
description: Practise thirty days in a row. Consistency beats intensity at this.

title: Through a module
description: Finish the first module — how ranges work, and what a mixed hand means.

title: Preflop fundamentals
description: Finish every lesson in the track.

title: Sharp on a spot
description: Hold 90% recent accuracy on any one skill, over at least 30 answers.
